Zenith
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 

 

 

__
 
• The word "Zenith" means the best, highest, or most successful point or time. (सबसे अच्छा, उच्चतम या सबसे सफल बिंदु या समय)

 
 
• Example: *Their popularity reached its **zenith**__ in the mid-1990s.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word is "Bottom."
 
• The word "Bottom" means the lowest part of something. (सबसे नीचे का हिस्‍सा, तल)
 __
 
• Example:* The ship had sunk to the **bottom**__ of the sea.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
